# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Still Rising Fast  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher prices; lock in pricing on neutral‑risk parts now and push for volume discounts on elevated‑risk items.

## What changed
- Market supply risk slipped to **71.6** (‑1.4) while price‑trend rose to **87.0** (‑1.2), keeping the market “Elevated” and “Rising fast”[1].  
- TSMC’s 3‑month revenue jumped **+56 % YoY**, outpacing its typical **+33.6 %**, tightening fab capacity[3].  
- Korea’s chip‑led exports surged **+100 % YoY** in early Nov, a leading indicator of demand pressure on supply and price[4].  
- Semiconductor PPI surged **+32.6 % annualized** over the last three months, feeding both price and supply stress[1].  
- Global chip sales hit **$172.6 B** in Sep 2026, up **+148.3 % YoY**, amplifying demand‑side tightness[2].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**; channel stock **27,071** units (≈17.6 weeks of supply).  
- Price **$5.56** for qty‑1, **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk **52.8** (Neutral); price trend **68.9**.  
- Call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 62 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal order cadence[10].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – **Elevated** (70.7, –1.3), **Rising** (84.0), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – **Rising** (69.0, –1.1), **Rising** (76.5), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – **Rising** (68.5, –1.3), **Rising** (82.0), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – **Rising** (67.1, –1.2), **Rising** (81.5), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – **Rising** (66.0, –1.3), **Rising** (78.2), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time **52 weeks** vs 12‑week norm; price 129 % above target.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – 52‑week lead, price +41 % vs target.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – 52‑week lead, price +60 % vs target.  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – 52‑week lead, price +42 % vs target.  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – 52‑week lead, price **+2,257 %** vs target.

## Outlook
- Chip prices have a **70 %** chance to rise in the next 3 months (expected **+2.5 %**, 80 % range **‑9.22 % to +14.21 %**, model‑tested edge).  
- Over 6 months, price‑rise probability falls to **55 %** (expected **+4.99 %**, 80 % range **‑10.24 % to +20.22 %**, trend‑following baseline).  
- Fab utilization likely tightens in 3 months with **62 %** probability (expected **+1.79 pts**, 80 % range **‑1.74 to +5.33 pts**, baseline).  
- Same for 6 months: **60 %** chance of tighter capacity (expected **+3.59 pts**, 80 % range **‑2.21 to +9.39 pts**).

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing now** on neutral‑risk parts like the Infineon MOSFET (IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to avoid the 62 % upside price risk while preserving normal lead times.  
2. **Demand volume discounts** on the five elevated‑risk items with 52‑week lead times; cite the 79‑plus supply‑risk scores and extreme price premiums as leverage.  
3. **Secure supply guarantees** (e.g., committed shipment windows) for logic and memory parts, referencing TSMC’s unusually high loading and Korea’s export surge as evidence of tightening fab capacity.
